summary: Educational Pop It for kids. Learn letters, numbers, & shapes by popping bubbles
description: Welcome to this educational Pop It fidget game, the perfect entertainment for kids who love doing puzzles and popping bubbles! This sensory game, besides being ideal for relaxing, has a didactic factor: babies can learn words and improve cognitive skills such as concentration and dexterity while having fun. In this Pop It sensory game you will find a variety of puzzles with silhouettes of letters, numbers, geometric shapes, animals, food and many more! Put all the pop it pieces together to complete the puzzle and then enjoy the satisfying feeling of popping all the bubbles of the pop it anti-stress fidget toy. With a simple and intuitive interface, this relaxing and educational pop it fidget toys is easy to play for children of all ages. In addition, the game features sounds that tell children what letter, number or shape they have formed. Pop It is an ideal way to learn numbers, letters and shapes and learn to match words to pictures. It's time to complete puzzles and enjoy the bubble squeezing effect and learn vocabulary! Children can choose their favorite pop it from several categories in this sensory game: - Letters - Numbers - Geometric shapes - Words: animals, food, flowers and many more! If you are looking for relaxing, fun and educational entertainment this children's bubble pop it game is ideal for you. Besides being a stress-reducing and calming toy, with this educational version, children can even develop important skills such as memory, hand-eye coordination and attention. It is also a great way to learn first words or start writing letters and numbers.
